SIKA® STABILIZER-4 R AU: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sika_stabilizer-4rau.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description.
    - Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU is a ready to use liquid-based viscosity modifying admixture. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU improves stability and segregation resistance of concrete mixes without significant reduction of slump or flow, resulting in improved surface quality and aesthetics. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU is suitable for various types of concrete. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU has been found to improve plastic properties of Self Consolidating Concrete (SCC) as well as high slump conventional concrete mixes, and mixes containing manufactured sand and/or poorly graded aggregates.
    - Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU helps stabilize the air void system in freshly mixed and placed concrete and increases the overall concrete stability. Sika® Stabilizer- 4 R AU is compatible with Sika® ViscoCrete® high range water reducing admixtures and is recommended for precast and ready mix concrete applications.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU is suitable for usage in cases when:
    - Improved flow & aesthetics of low slump extruded concrete mixes
    - Higher resistance to segregation is required
    - Improved stability during transportation is required
    - Manufactured sand and/or “gap-graded” coarse aggregate is used
    - Migration of air within the concrete mixture is observed
    - Fluctuation of water content in aggregates causes inconsistent production

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Viscosity Modifying Admixture
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU meets the requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for type SN (special-purpose normal setting) admixture for concrete.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU increases overall mix cohesiveness without promoting concrete stiffening, which ultimately results in easier placement, reduced consolidation effort and improved aesthetics.
    - Enhances stability of concrete matrix integrity during high slump placements
    - Increases the cohesiveness of lean and harsh mix designs
    - Reduces segregation and bleeding
    - Improves surface finishability
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Light blue liquid
    - Density: 1.01 g/cm³approximately
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU is available in 1000 litres IBC, 10 litres container and bulk deliveries.
    - Shelf life: Shelf life when stored in dry warehouse conditions between 5 °C and 35 °C is six months.
    - Storage conditions: Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU should be stored above 5 °C . Protect from frost and direct sunlight.If frozen, thaw and agitate thoroughly to return to normal state.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Compatibility: Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU can be used in conjunction with most of the Sika Concrete products, except Sika VMA . Trials are always recommended before use.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Dosage rates will vary according to materials used, ambient conditions and the requirements of a specific project. Sika recommends dosage at 200–1500 ml/100 kg of cementitious materials. Dosage rates outside the recommended range may be used where extreme ambient conditions are encountered or unusual project conditions require special consideration. In this case please contact your local Sales Representative .
4.4 Dispensing. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU should be added to the fresh concrete after all other mix ingredients have been blended together. Addition of the Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU directly into the concrete too early may promote clumping of the mix materials. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU may also be dispensed into freshly mixed concrete in a ready mix truck at the concrete plant or at the job site. When added on site, mixer should rotate its drum at maximum speed for a minimum of 2 minutes/m³. Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU should on no account be added to a dry mix.
4.5 Further information. There maybe a slight decrease in slump or spread when using Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU. This may require an increase of HRW (Sika ViscoCrete).

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Stabilizer-4 R AU, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sika_stabilizer-4rau.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Stabilizer 4R AU, version 05/08/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/MSDS%20Sika%C2%AE%20Stabilizer%204R%20AU%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
